title: eiffel
text: Gustave Eiffel was the French civil engineer whose company designed and built the Eiffel Tower in Paris, completed in 1889 for the World's Fair.

title: eiffel

title: everest

title: photosynthesis
text: Photosynthesis converts light energy into chemical energy inside the chloroplasts of plant cells, producing glucose and oxygen.

title: photosynthesis

title: amazon
